brief:
Zeteo reported that critics are accusing Western feminists of hypocrisy over their response to conditions in Gaza, where miscarriages have tripled this year and Palestinian mothers face severe malnutrition. The criticism questions whether global feminism can claim moral authority if it ignores documented harm to women and children in the territory.

The accusations point to a divide in international feminist activism. Critics argue that Western feminist organizations have failed to mobilize around health crises affecting Palestinian women with the same intensity they apply to other global women's rights issues. The charge raises questions about whose suffering receives sustained advocacy and attention from major feminist movements worldwide.
dek: What exactly is global feminism about if it doesn’t care about the fact that miscarriages tripled in the Strip this year, or that Palestinian mothers are so malnourished they can’t feed their babies?.
title: Western feminists silent on Gaza crisis, critics argue.
